newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 17.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 17.

text.p: These were the main headlines on Latvia's state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two of the three largest political forces Fatherland & Freedom and Latvia's Way have formed a joint faction, the biggest in the Riga Municipality with 13 deputies.
- The foreign ministry's state secretary Maris Riekstinsh left for a working visit to Helsinki to continue talks on a visa-free travel regime.
- Lithuania's parliament said it will continue direct contacts with its counterparts in other countries to complement the activities of its Foreign Ministry.
